sql_templates.description: Select upcoming corporate events along with current stage and technical context.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT ce.symbol, ce.event_type, ce.event_date, ce.purpose_raw, ce.detail, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal 
FROM signals.corporate_events ce 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol 
WHERE ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE 
AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
ORDER BY ce.event_date ASC 
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Select recent results with verdict and commentary for sector-relative comparison.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT ra.symbol, ra.company_name, ra.industry, ra.verdict, ra.pl_commentary, ra.bs_commentary, ra.cf_commentary 
FROM scores.results_analysis ra 
JOIN signals.corporate_events ce ON ra.symbol = ce.symbol 
WHERE ra.period_end = (SELECT MAX(period_end) FROM scores.results_analysis WHERE symbol = ra.symbol) 
AND ce.event_type = 'RESULTS' 
AND ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week' 
ORDER BY ra.verdict DESC 
LIMIT 10;
